question: Prakesh starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 13 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Prakesh starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the south.

He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 13 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdd86fef8f33bb614961fbaad9d16fc99daaca3cf556103c18cbbd177fd87454.png] 

Thus, Prakesh should drive 2 km (9 km - 7 km) in the west direction in order to reach point A again.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
